title: Road to a Bigger Back update
summary: NH shows his back progress after focusing on upper traps, lats and rear delts: pull-ups and pullovers built visible lats, rear delts now pop, and his traps look better after leaning out on a recomp. He says posing still needs work and the lats remain underdeveloped.
claims: His back specialization focused on the three weakest areas: upper traps, lats and rear delts
Pull-ups and pullovers gave him a mind-muscle connection with the lats and taught him to flare them, so he now has a front lat spread
Lats improve a physique regardless of your proportions
To build round rear delts, build the lats underneath: developed lats push the delt up and out and make it pop
Developed lats also let you push out the long head of the triceps in poses
His traps grew less than other areas but look better because the recomp leaned him out
Upper traps don't need much direct work: weighted stretches largely take care of them, plus shrugs
You can never have too much upper back
His rhomboids and lower back pop from deadlifts and good mornings
His upper lats were always strong; the lower lats were the weak point and responded to pull-ups and pullovers
His mid and lower traps have always dominated his physique, built by stretch under heavy deadlifts
He wants to enter a natural bodybuilding competition as soon as one is available
exercises: built lat width and lower lats
developed lat connection and lower lats
grows rhomboids, lower back and mid/lower traps
